pictures.name: CIG1-Antioch-Bishop
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A colonnaded street in ancient Antioch in Syria, early 2nd century, at dawn. In the middle, Ignatius of Antioch, a grey-bearded man of about sixty with a kind lined face, in a dark wool robe and a pale wrap, light iron chains on his wrists, stands calm and upright while two Roman soldiers in red tunics and bronze helmets fasten the chains; a small group of his people, men and women in simple robes, watch from a doorway, one woman weeping into her veil, a young man reaching out. Gold dawn light on the columns, deep blue shadows. Calm courage, love. No violence. No text, no letters, no logos.

A dusty Roman road winding through the dry hills of Asia Minor at midday. A column of ten Roman soldiers in red cloaks and helmets marches, some scowling; in the middle of them walks Ignatius of Antioch, a grey-bearded man of about sixty with a kind lined face, in a dark wool robe and a pale wrap, light iron chains on his wrists, serene, speaking kindly to the nearest soldier, who looks away scornfully. Golden heat haze, deep blue shadows of cypress trees. Patience amid harshness. No violence. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CIG3-Smyrna-Visitors
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A sunlit courtyard in the Greek city of Smyrna, early 2nd century, the blue sea glimpsed beyond. In the middle, Ignatius of Antioch, a grey-bearded man of about sixty with a kind lined face, in a dark wool robe and a pale wrap, light iron chains on his wrists, sits on a stone bench, smiling, as visitors from other cities, men and women in travel cloaks, kneel to greet him and press his hands; two Roman soldiers lean bored against a column. Warm gold light, deep blue shade under a vine trellis. Joy, communion, welcome. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CIG4-Writing-Letter
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A small lamp-lit room at night in Smyrna. In the middle, Ignatius of Antioch, a grey-bearded man of about sixty with a kind lined face, in a dark wool robe and a pale wrap, light iron chains on his wrists, sits at a low table dictating with an open hand, eyes bright, while a young scribe in a pale tunic writes on a papyrus scroll with a reed pen. A Roman soldier dozes by the door. Warm gold oil-lamp light, deep blue night through the window. Passion, tenderness. The papyrus shows only blurred marks, no readable writing. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CIG5-Ship-To-Rome
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A Roman merchant ship with a square sail crossing the deep blue Aegean at sunset. At the rail in the middle stands Ignatius of Antioch, a grey-bearded man of about sixty with a kind lined face, in a dark wool robe and a pale wrap, light iron chains on his wrists, looking west toward the gold horizon, peaceful. Behind him two soldiers coil rope. In the foreground on the dock left behind, a group of Christians hold up rolled letters and wave farewell. Gold sunset light on the sea, deep blue waves. Peace, hope, farewell. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CIG6-Today-Mass-World
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern scene painted in the same sacred oil style, divided by soft light into three joined panels in one tall picture: at the top, a joyful Mass in a Nigerian church with dancers in bright patterned cloth; in the middle, a packed church in Manila with a choir and fans; at the bottom, a small Polish village church in snow with an old organ. In each, the same simple altar, bread and cup lifted. Warm gold light in every panel, deep blue shadows. Unity in difference. No text, no letters, no logos.
